payload.title: Wavelet Analysis with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the use of wavelet analysis and wavelet coherence in the Pyleoclim library, focusing on the EPICA Dome C ice core record. It covers loading and visualizing deuterium data, performing wavelet analysis, customizing frequency ranges, and conducting significance testing. Additionally, it explores the relationship between temperature proxies and atmospheric CO2 using wavelet coherence. The notebook provides insights into handling both evenly and unevenly spaced data.
